title: Webb Telescope Reveals Sharper Detail in the Pillars of Creation
summary: New infrared imaging from the James Webb Space Telescope shows finer structure inside the Pillars of Creation than earlier Hubble images could resolve, including previously hidden young stars.

title: IceCube Detects High-Energy Neutrinos Traced to a Distant Galaxy
summary: The IceCube Neutrino Observatory, buried in Antarctic ice, continues to trace ultra-high-energy neutrinos back to their source galaxies, helping map the most extreme particle accelerators in the universe.

title: Researchers Push Quantum Entanglement to Larger Physical Scales
summary: Experimental groups continue to demonstrate entanglement between progressively larger mechanical and photonic systems, narrowing the gap between quantum behavior and the everyday scale.

title: New Measurements Add to the Ongoing Hubble Constant Debate
summary: Independent measurement techniques still disagree on exactly how fast the universe is expanding, a persistent puzzle known as the Hubble tension.

title: Mathematicians Report Progress on a Long-Standing Prime Number Conjecture
summary: A new paper narrows the bounds on gaps between consecutive prime numbers, building on decades of incremental work toward the twin prime conjecture.
